scope: SERIAL ABSTRACT MODEL; metadata actions atomic by assumption; page steps simplify native byte operations; no RTOS, IRQ/FIQ, DMA, cache, transport or independent recovery emulated
conditional_safety: All eight-page reads begun through the coordinator see one committed source generation, if every writer/reader participates and no aborted partial draw is returned to IDLE. No liveness claim without return/fairness bounds.

actions: scan pages0..2 of A without reader lease
caller waits for itself before outer DRAW can finish
UI gate refuses synchronous progress worker
caller interprets ordinary return as completed critical service

queue_drain.limit: Finite witness plus inductive repeating transition; not a hardware rate claim.

candidate_domain_contract.entry: IDLE and known complete source, no active borrow/reader
candidate_domain_contract.critical: exclude new compositions and periodic scans, execute complete original progress composite; internal draw precedes internal read
candidate_domain_contract.exit: only on actual return; no forced release while native code may still run
candidate_domain_contract.remaining: all callers, fatal entries, hardware waits, latency bounds and IRQ writers must still be qualified
